text:
customer-joe: Hey team — seeing partial SSE responses from our app behind Azure App Gateway + Cloudflare. Stream cuts off after ~90s idle and client reconnects, but next connection gets 401 on retry even though token is still valid. Billing spike from retries.

lena_support: Sorry to hear that — can you paste a short curl repro and the request/response headers?

customer-joe: repro: `curl -v -N -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://api.prod.example.com/v1/stream?id=abc`
response: starts streaming then after ~90s connection closes with `ERR_CONNECTION_RESET`. Client then retries twice quickly, gets 401 on second attempt.

lena_support: Interesting — Azure AppGW default idle timeout is 90s. Cloudflare also does keepalive pooling and Cloudflare Workers can coalesce connections. Suspect idle probe + proxy buffering causing half-close then auth cache mismatch on reconnect.

ingram_eng: Can you paste the server-side connection logs around the disconnect? Need the connection close reason and any 502/504 from front doors.

customer-joe: Server logs (snippet):
```
[2024-11-12T14:05:23Z] conn=8435 stream-start id=abc token=tokid123
[2024-11-12T14:06:53Z] conn=8435 idle-timeout observed from upstream: keepalive closed
[2024-11-12T14:06:53Z] conn=8435 stream-ended bytes=1024 reason=peer-reset
[2024-11-12T14:06:54Z] auth: refresh attempt on reconnect for tokid123 -> refresh-succeeded
[2024-11-12T14:06:54Z] conn=8440 new-reconnect id=abc token=tokid123 status=200
[2024-11-12T14:06:55Z] conn=8441 reconnect attempt id=abc token=tokid123 status=401 auth-cache-miss
```

maria_prod: The pattern looks like: Azure AppGW closes the backend connection at its idle timeout (90s), Cloudflare caches the TCP session to another origin causing client to reconnect with a stale connection mapping. The second reconnect gets auth-cache-miss because we rotate short-lived session ids on reconnect.

ops-oncall: Can you try one change to validate hypothesis: 1) disable Cloudflare HTTP/2 multiplexing (or set `proxy_buffering off` equivalent) for this endpoint, 2) bump AppGW idle timeout to 10m (temporary), 3) enable token reuse on reconnect for 30s.

customer-joe: Will try now. Quick note: our client does exponential backoff but initial retries are 2s and 4s which caused the billing spike.

lena_support: Also worth instrumenting `X-Forwarded-Proto` and `CF-Connecting-IP` + `Via` headers; capture `Connection: keep-alive` vs `Connection: close`. If AppGW inserts `Proxy-Connection` header it can confuse backend HTTP server and cause early half-close.

ingram_eng: If you can share pcap or tcpdump showing FIN vs RST that helps. A FIN from AppGW then a RST from Cloudflare or client is diagnostic.

customer-joe: After bumping AppGW to 10m and disabling HTTP/2 pooling, stream stayed open past 5m, no 401 on reconnects. Looks promising.

maria_prod: Good. Longer-term fixes: 1) implement short heartbeat frames on SSE (`:heartbeat

`) at 20–30s to keep proxies happy, 2) add graceful reconnect token refresh path (accept tokens within a short overlap window), 3) document proxy-specific recommendations (AppGW idle timeout, Cloudflare pooling settings).

lena_support: I'll open an internal KB and escalate to docs + infra to add a streaming health-check/heartbeat guide. Will also add a note to billing team to refund the spike if we confirm repeated automatic retries caused by infrastructure timeouts. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Deployed infra patch `stream-heartbeat-flag` to staging at 2024-11-12T16:00:00Z.

ops-oncall: Follow-ups: collect a minimal repro that reproduces with only AppGW (no CF) and vice-versa. Prefer two repros so we can file bugs upstream (Azure / Cloudflare).

customer-joe: Thanks all. I'll run the two repros and update this thread with tcpdump + curl logs.

lena_support: Thank you — closing loop once we get the captures. If you need a quick script to generate SSE heartbeats, ping me and I can share a Node/Go snippet.
